versions.content: A verification of a certificate shall only be started if the cer- tificate is in the status KEYM_CERTIFICATE_PARSED_NOT_VALIDATED. The veri- fication shall be triggered at the latest by a call to one of the functions KeyM_Verify Certificate(), KeyM_VerifyCertificates() or KeyM_VerifyCertificateChain().
